title: Post-treatment care plan — Sarah Okonkwo (tooth #9 root canal)

detail.description: Definitive crown on tooth #9 by a dentist Sarah establishes as her dental home (she has none yet) — the endodontically treated tooth needs definitive coronal coverage; a lingual direct composite (D2330) restores the access in the interim.
Follow-up periapical radiograph of tooth #9 at 6 months to confirm periapical healing.
Post-operative discomfort: ibuprofen 400 mg by mouth as needed.

note.text: Post-treatment care plan surfaced to Sarah's patient-facing app alongside the referral-complete milestone at Interaction 4, and transmitted to the referring teledentistry provider as part of the closed-loop summary. The definitive crown is deliberately deferred to a dentist Sarah establishes as her dental home, because she has none yet (not Barton Springs), consistent with the operative note. ASSUMPTION: who places the crown is not stated in the narrative; the owner confirms the crown is still needed.
